decision: D010 revision 1 remains unchanged: valid UFC input requires explicit Boolean doLog.
local_resolution: Both Java exclusion helpers use Boolean.TRUE.equals(doLog), matching their existing exposure predicate. Omitted/null doLog therefore keeps the pre-existing non-exposure ordinary allocation behavior.
limits: This is Java-local malformed-input compatibility. It does not introduce a shared missing-field default or replace separate strict required-boolean ingestion work.
validation: Exact a4d3dfb native suites:2454 passed. Omitted/null regressions pass in both providers; restoring the old predicate causes two failures per provider. Both runtime paths pass5 tests each; all90 policy cases per path pass.
authorization: Current user requested independent implementation pass followed by review remediation across the three existing SDK PRs.
